card.problem: Every strategy gated so far (h2, h2v2, all six earlier gap variants, the h0 live bot) failed concentration at 0.79-3.14, meaning a few uncapped trend days carried all the net, and h2/h2v2 failed costs at 0.85-0.97x because a session-long hold earns about 0.2bp a day. Nothing so far has had a payoff that is many small, similar-sized wins of tens of bp.
card.motivation: Fading a short-horizon intraday stretch with a capped take-profit produces exactly that payoff shape: a stretch of k sigmas over the last hour is roughly 20-40bp on NIFTY, so a half-way reversion clears the ~2.5bp round-trip cost (config/costs.yaml futures set) by well over 3x, and a fixed take caps any single day's contribution. It is the opposite of the trend bets that have all died, so it is not a near-duplicate of anything in memory.
card.approach: Between 09:45 and 14:45, fade the 1-minute close when its 60-bar z-score is beyond k, take profit at 0.25 ATR, stop at 0.5 ATR, flat by 15:15.
card.plan: Features z = zscore(field close, n 60), m = minute_of_day, atr(days 14). Entry long: z < -p.k and m >= 30 and m <= 330; short: z > p.k with the same window; max_per_day 2. Exit take_atr 0.25, stop_atr 0.5, time 15:15. CPCV over k in [2.0, 2.5, 3.0]; demo gate.
card.mechanism: Impatient flow (stop-outs, retail option-hedge deltas, market orders from algos chasing a move) pushes the 1-minute price away from its recent level faster than liquidity refills; whoever supplies that liquidity is paid the overshoot as the book refills. The other side keeps paying because the demand for immediacy is not price-sensitive.
card.rule: long: zscore(close,60) < -p.k and 30 <= minute_of_day <= 330; short: zscore > p.k; exit take 0.25 ATR, stop 0.5 ATR, or 15:15

k.source: Bollinger-band convention is 2 sigma; raised to 2.5 so the expected half-way reversion (~10-20bp at NIFTY's 1-hour sigma) is at least 3x the ~2.5bp futures round-trip cost in config/costs.yaml; grid 2.0/2.5/3.0

kill: best 5 days carry >= 50% of net, even with the 0.25 ATR take cap
hit rate below 0.5 with take smaller than stop, i.e. the reversion is not there
